title: Bryan Johnson's oral health protocol: nine steps to teenage-level gums
summary: Bryan details how he reversed receding gums, eroding teeth and bruxism over three years on Blueprint. He explains which dental baselines to measure, his nine-step daily oral care routine, and hygiene tips on sugar, acid, hydration and brushing timing.

principles.text: Get a dental baseline: attachment loss, pocket depth and plaque index.
principles.quote: With anything with Blueprint, it’s important to understand your baseline. Ask your dentist to evaluate:

principles.text: Healthy gums have 1-3 mm pocket depth and should not bleed easily.
principles.quote: Healthy gums have a pocket depth of 1-3 mm. Three years ago I had several pockets that were 5 mm deep.

principles.text: Layer cleaning twice daily: Waterpik first, then floss, brush, tongue scraper and mouthwash.
principles.quote: After using the Waterpik to loosen particles, I use floss for plaque and debris removal.

principles.text: Address nighttime teeth grinding with a bruxism device.
principles.quote: For 20 years I was grinding my teeth at night. If you have Bruxism, I strongly encourage you to address it.

principles.text: See the dentist at least twice a year to catch problems and remove hardened plaque.
principles.quote: Make sure you visit your dentist at least 2 times a year. It is important to identify problems early and remove hardened plaque.

principles.text: Wait 30 minutes after eating before brushing, since enamel is temporarily softened.
principles.quote: I avoid brushing my teeth 30 minutes after eating as tooth enamel is temporarily softened.
